verified: edh-d-101 review (Commander coordinator D, EDHREC #6,177; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30)), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall ruling of 2024-09-20 and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: for each opponent up to one target artifact or enchantment that player controls (CR 115.1, 601.2c: TargetSpec.perOpponent); as it resolves each player in turn order (CR 101.4) chooses which of the chosen permanents they control they exile, then all of those are exiled at once (the ruling); then, if one or more of the chosen permanents are still on the battlefield (a target exiled is a new object, CR 400.7), you search your library for up to that many land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle (CR 701.23a) (eff.edhd101.eachOpp.chooseTarget.controllerMayExile.searchRemaining).

edh-d-101 review (Commander coordinator D, EDHREC #6,818; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30)), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings of 2018-07-13 and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: at the beginning of your end step you may manifest the top card of your library (CR 701.40a); the cost 'Exile a face-down permanent you control face up' (CostDef exileFrom.faceUp: the permanent is revealed and exiled face up, CR 708.9, 406.3), then 'You may play that card this turn' is a permission of exactly the card the cost exiled (ObjRef costExiled, CR 400.7), for you, until end of turn; normal timing and land plays apply (the rulings).

edh-d-101 review (Commander coordinator D, EDHREC #7,339; tuning half), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings of 2018-04-27 and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: flying, trample; when it enters, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card and put that card into your hand; if its mana value is 4 or greater, the process is done again (eff.stdcardcopy1.repeatProcess.again: the copy of the effect up to the marker, CR 608.2c; a run that exiles no nonland card ends it, the ruling); then it deals 1 damage to you for each card put into your hand this way, counted over every run and dealt at once (the ruling; effects/handlers/control.ts gathers the runs' results).

edh-d-101 review (Commander coordinator D, EDHREC #7,506; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30)), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings of 2019-07-12 and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: legendary spells you cast cost {1} less; exile two legendary cards from your graveyard: until end of turn each legendary card in your graveyard gains 'You may play this card from your graveyard.' (sta.edhd101.playSelf.fromGraveyard for the quoted ability; the grant is stored as a permission of exactly the cards in your graveyard as it resolves, CR 611.2c, effects/handlers/lasting.ts: a card put there later, or one that leaves and comes back, has no permission, the ruling); timing and land plays are the usual ones (the ruling).

edh-d-101 review (Commander coordinator D, EDHREC #7,810; tuning half), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings of 2021-02-05 and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: choose one -- destroy all creatures; or destroy all planeswalkers (CR 700.2); then, whichever mode was chosen (the ruling; the program's steps after its modes, lower/ability.ts#withModes), you return a creature or planeswalker card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, chosen as it resolves (no target, the ruling), X the amount of {S} spent to cast this spell (q snowSpent, CR 107.4h; 0 for a copy or no snow mana, the rulings).

edh-d-101 review (Commander coordinator D, EDHREC #9,295; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30)), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings of 2019-08-23 and 2022-12-08 and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: flying; whenever a source an opponent controls deals damage to it, that source's controller (as it last existed, CR 608.2h) may sacrifice as many permanents as the damage dealt; if they don't, they lose that much life (eff.t34.loseLife.unlessTheyPayCost with the cost count 'that many', CR 118.12a: all of them or the life; a player who can't sacrifice enough loses the life, the rulings); madness {3}{B}{B}.

edh-d-101 review (Commander coordinator D, EDHREC #9,699; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30)), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings of 2024-04-12 and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: {T}: add {U}; when you spend this mana to cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 3 or less (the X chosen counts, the ruling), you may exile that spell instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard as it resolves (rid.edhd101.mana.youSpend.mayExileSpellAsItResolves: an optional replacement, CR 614.1a, 616.1, recorded as exiled with the Foundry, CR 607.2a); {3}{U}{U}, {T}: you may cast any number of spells from among cards exiled with this artifact without paying their mana costs, during the resolution (eff.edhd101.castAnyNumber.linkedExiled.free, CR 608.2g, 118.9; X is 0, the rulings); activate only as a sorcery.
